content.text: {"name":"composition_stock_vs_flow_spread","hypothesis":"Groups whose stock rate V06 is high relative to flow rate V04, cross-sectionally standardized and smoothed over 6 months, have lower next-month returns, because a stock-heavy composition signals slack.
